title: Corrected two-root multi-key writer gateway
summary: Successor to the reworked v2 proposal. It retains two disjoint development roots and sixteen counterbalanced tool-by-mode keys while fixing the source protocol, visibility roles, parser and scoring definitions, clustered uncertainty, failure precedence, complete workload boundary, claim wording, and minimal CPU capability fence.
system_thesis: THINK supplies child-authored lived endpoints, DREAM projects a fixed visible-state-to-endpoint derivative, and SLEEP writes it with a target-masked LoRA. The gateway isolates only multi-key endpoint-policy carriage; it neither changes nor claims the full organism or C11.

context_files.purpose: Verbatim directive to continue ordinary scouts while parking the full C11 guard.
Corrected self-contained protocol, authority, workload, gates, claim, and lifecycle.
Canonical requested and forbidden implementation authority.
Adjudicated v2 rework consensus whose six accepted concerns this successor disposes.
Terminal broad-habit result motivating a multi-key selective-binding test.

nodes.before: V2 two-root multi-key proposal with ambiguous labels, incomplete scoring/workload semantics, and role-coarse visibility.
nodes.after: Two identity-, case-, surface-, and RNG-disjoint roots under one shared model/recipe, each with a matched complementary sixteen-key adapter pair and exact source/read/reducer semantics.
nodes.rationale: Retain the high-information design while making its execution and bounded reading deterministic.

nodes.before: Key-level bootstrap, underspecified likelihood and denominators, and an unreachable binding-with-spill label.
nodes.after: Exact continuation likelihood, TV and validity denominators, exhaustive stratified tool-cluster stability, mutually exclusive labels, and ordered two-root reduction.
nodes.rationale: Prevent pseudoreplication, parser-dependent rescue, and ambiguous terminal classifications.

nodes.before: Basic path isolation without an explicit CPU capability sentinel or complete pre-source resource stop.
nodes.after: Simple fail-if-exists/hash lifecycle plus narrow CPU sentinels and a complete three-A40-hour pre-source projection, while C11 remains untouched.
nodes.rationale: Enforce the implementation-only grant without importing final-run governance machinery.

edges.before: V2 named pair eligibility and a provenance-only outcome but left source turns, roles, retries, and complement matching incomplete.
edges.after: Exactly two child emissions around one public outcome, no semantic retry, typed trusted-harness access, lowest-ordinal pair selection, and a fixed state-to-exact-child-ACT derivative.
edges.rationale: Preserve child authorship without answer leakage or repeat/flip training shortcuts.

edges.before: Held materials were named but their loading boundary and complete workload were not closed.
edges.after: Held/oracle material is unavailable until all four adapter commits; complete symbolic calls and caps are fixed before source; every invalid output remains in the denominator.
edges.rationale: Make held evaluation noninterfering and resource-bounded.

loops.before: V2 source, compile, four-fit, and report loop with six accepted review concerns.
loops.after: Freeze geometry and symbolic workload; acquire paired lived endpoints; compile exact target-masked derivatives; verify matched complement geometry; fit four adapters only after later authority; commit all four; then open oracle/held material and apply exact per-root gates without pooling.
loops.trigger: Implementation begins only after exact v3 ratification; model execution begins only after a separate immutable execution manifest, dual PASS review, and exact execution ratification.
reads: complete source trajectories and pair-eligibility receipts
exact compiled bytes and loss masks
held generation and continuation scores after all adapter commits
writes: development-only deterministic materials and CPU fault receipts
four isolated adapters only under later execution authority
ordered per-root labels and one no-pooling run decision
loops.stop_condition: Stop without replacement on any authority, source, geometry, workload, optimization, assay, interface, spill, identity, visibility, or receipt failure; only identical-byte infrastructure replay may be prospectively allowed.
loops.rationale: Directly test multi-key selective carriage at bounded cost without C11 or qualification scope.

claims.before: V2 could be read as success on every key and as statistically independent roots.
claims.after: Only after both roots pass: across two identity-, case-, surface-, and seed-disjoint roots sharing one model/recipe, aggregate and stratum generation gates passed, the directional teacher-forced gate passed at least 12/16 keys and 6/8 per stratum, fixed interface gates passed, and no bound spill family crossed its threshold.
claims.evidence_needed: Both roots independently satisfy every exact source, optimization, explicit-map oracle, generated binding, teacher-forced, clustered-stability, interface, and spill gate; no pooling or replacement.

claims.before: Unqualified 'across sixteen keys' and 'independent roots' wording in the reworked v2 proposal.
claims.after: Retired and replaced by exact_scope.md section 11.
claims.evidence_needed: No evidence; v2 is proposal-only and NOT_RUN.

acceptance_tests.setup: Deterministically materialize both roots, maps, cases, row geometry, registries, complete call graph, and workload maxima under permutations and restart.
acceptance_tests.expected: Counts equal exact_scope sections 3-9; target marginals and complement bijections match; the pre-source projection formula covers all 5,056 emissions, 102,400 output tokens, 1,536 scored sequences, four fits, and loads.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Geometry or the three-A40-hour pre-source budget is not deterministically closed.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate every privileged source field, held/oracle field, target author, renderer registry, serialized model bytes, mask, EOS, stage order, and report feedback edge.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every mutation fails; clean model-visible bytes respect the exact role matrix and held material cannot load before four commits.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Answer, admission, outcome shortcut, or report information can leak into child/compiler/trainer paths.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise the exact two-emission source session, strict parser, paired eligibility, canonical lowest selection, source shortfalls, invalid actions, discovery-order changes, semantic retries, repairs, and replacements.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only two exact child-authored successful endpoints per key and four eligible tools per stratum survive; every forbidden mutation yields SOURCE_INVALID without replacement.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Source authorship or success filtering is adaptive, leaky, or irreproducible.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate context, complement targets, action target lengths, order, masks, EOS, steps, seeds, node, or optimizer geometry within each mirror pair.
acceptance_tests.expected: Clean pairs have the exact row complement bijection and matched nuisance geometry; every mutation fails before fitting.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Adapter differences can arise from unmatched training dose or geometry.

acceptance_tests.setup: Enumerate valid and adversarial ASCII ACT/DONE emissions, missing/errors, all denominators, and four-tick action sequences.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only one strict first ACT can score; invalid/flood cases remain denominator zeros; structural interface labels follow exact precedence and later actions never help.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Parser or action proliferation can rescue binding accuracy.

acceptance_tests.setup: Enumerate threshold and near-threshold q, I, NLL, TV, emission, BA, tau, g, exhaustive tool-cluster resamples, root-label pairs, missing, and non-finite fixtures.
acceptance_tests.expected: Likelihood and aggregation are byte-deterministic; all seven root labels are reachable and exclusive; only two MULTIKEY_BINDING_PASS roots set run_pass true.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Scientific decisions or claim wording are ambiguous or use the wrong inferential unit.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise fail-if-exists, realpath/symlink, overwrite, stale marker, hash, partial stage, preserved failure, identical-byte infrastructure replay, and CPU sentinels for model/tokenizer/trainer/device/network/subprocess/adapter-write hooks.
acceptance_tests.expected: Simple scout lifecycle fails closed and CPU authority cannot perform any forbidden execution or touch child, parent, CompilerGym, PCFL, or C11 roots.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The narrow implementation grant can escape into execution or contaminate authoritative roots.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh independent reviewer and separate author-side advocate inspect identical immutable execution-manifest bytes, every T01-T07 receipt, exact workload projection, and claim boundary.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both PASS without unresolved concern before a separate exact human execution ratification is requested; the advocate cannot override rejection.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The corrected scout is not ready for model/GPU execution.

human_boundary.decision_question: Approve only the exact implementation and deterministic CPU/fault-test scope in v3 exact_scope.md and scope_proposal.json, with every execution, parenting, C11, claim, release, and submission action still forbidden?
forbidden_before_approval: authoring the named implementation or launcher files
running deterministic materialization or fault tests
model, tokenizer, trainer, or GPU execution
